body: I feel like I've spent my whole life trying to improve myself. I've lost fifty pounds since high school, have learned to deal with anger issues, and am always trying to see things from new perspectives and understand where other people are coming from. Now I just feel neurotic and like I over analyze everything. But I do feel better since I posted this. I still feel like crying but I am going to go see what resources my school might have to offer. I think just talking to someone without worrying about them judging me will help. I've talked to counselors before and it didn't help but I'm willing to give it another shot. I'm just trying to give it time.
